messages:
Maya: Hey team — planning a soft launch for a small peer-recognition program called 'Humble Halo' next Wed during lunch. Digital micro-badges in Slack + 30s peer shoutouts. Need volunteers for comms, infra, and a postcard fallback for onsite folks.
Samir: Love it. Scope?
Maya: Hybrid — virtual first, but we’ll print a tiny batch of thank-you postcards for onsite desks. Want low friction, no new accounts.
Jess: I can own the Slack bot wiring. Plan: a slash command — /halo give @handle <badge> <short-reason>. Will also emit an event for analytics.
Samir: Nice. Can we add a rate limit so it doesn’t get spammy?
Jess: Yes — planning 2 gives/min and a per-user cap of 10/day by default. I’ll post the config snippet after I set it up.
Katie: I’ll draft comms + the 1-pager for People Ops and Eng. Need final badge names and a short blurb for each.
Maya: Proposed badges: Helps Often, Problem Solver, Culture Spark, Ship-Minded, Teaching Moment. Short blurbs incoming.
Nora: For postcards — logistics: quantity estimate, printer timeline, address capture flow. Ops-bot, can you spin up a quick form?
Ops-bot: Created form: https://forms.redwood/humble-halo-postcards — fields: giver name, recipient name, mailing address, onsite desk? Form auto-closes in 7 days.
Samir: Can backend telemetry expose counts by team for QBRs? Would be useful to see adoption.
Jess: I’ll publish events to /events/humble-halo with payloads like 
```
{ "giver": "maya", "receiver": "samir", "badge": "Helps Often", "ts": 2179991234 }
```
(no PII in events).
Aleks: Could we surface a tiny dashboard in Optimize or even a shared sheet? Simple counts + top 5 receivers per week would be great.
Maya: Agree. Katie — can you capture KPIs we want in the 1-pager? (reach, postcards sent, top badges).
Katie: Yep — I’ll include launch cadence, comm timeline, sample Slack copy, and a small FAQ.
Nora: I can handle printing & batching if we approve ~$250 for 200 double-sided postcards. Who signs off?
Maya: I’ll submit the expense. Tagging @finance for quick review in the All-Hands pre-announce.
Samir: Volunteers for live moderation during lunch (monitor spam, answer questions)?
Katie: I can moderate 11:30–12:30 PT Wed for comms + quick FAQs.
Nora: I’ll own postcard fulfillment and address verification; need access to the form export.
Jess: I’ll deploy the bot to staging by Tue EOD and prod Wed morning. Will post the slash command and sample usage.
Maya: Quick ask — any objections to calling it a "soft launch" (internal pilot) vs full product? Soft launch gives us room to iterate. :party_parrot:
Samir: Soft launch sounds right. Also — small privacy note: events should not expose free-form reason text in analytics, only badge id and length bucket.
Jess: Yep — will redact free-text from analytics payloads, but keep it in the message for context.
Aleks: If we get traction, can we add a microvideo shoutout feature later (30s clips)? Not for launch, but tagging it as backlog.
Maya: Good idea — backlog it.
Maya: Final ask — short sync Fri 9:00 AM PT to confirm copy, bot config, and printer PO. 20 minutes. Who can make it?
Katie: I’m in.
Jess: In.
Nora: In.
Samir: In.
Aleks: I can join.
Maya: Great — I’ll send a calendar invite and drop the 1-pager draft here by Thu. Thanks everyone :heart:
